title: True evaluation of an AND gate
statement: For any natural number $n$, any finite list $cs$ of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, and any assignment $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, the AND gate with children $cs$ evaluates to true under $x$ if and only if every circuit in $cs$ evaluates to true under $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite list $cs$ of circuit trees on $n$ variables
